Decorative window film is a great option for adding privacy and style. Below, find out where you can use decorative film for glass.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted tinting network for car, home and office window tinting. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years. All of our films are exclusive to us (supplied by the largest supplier of window film in the world) and are government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality. Here is where you can use decorative frosted window film

Where You Can Use Decorative Film For Glass

Decorative frosted glass is great for office spaces. Because you can customise the designs for a decorative film for glass you can add your company logo – great for promoting your brand and adding a professional look to your office.

You can also customise a design for your decorative frosted glass in your home that compliments your home’s aesthetic. We also a have a range of designs you can choose from.

Decorative film for glass is not only suitable for exterior windows.

  • You can use it on the internal glass to add a unique feature to your home or office
  • Use it as a divider to create private internal spaces
  • Decorative frosted window film is often used for bathrooms as it creates privacy but still lets in natural light

We offer a lifetime warranty on residential applications and up to 15 years for commercial applications giving you complete peace of mind. All decorative frosted window film is also installed by professionally trained installers.

Get A Quote For Decorative Film For Glass Today

To find out more or get a quote for a decorative film for glass call 13 TINT or use our Store Finder to locate your nearest window tinting store. We can show you through our designs or you can speak to us about a custom design.
